title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00092 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:15: Bled off well to 185 bar and attampted to close DHSV while bleeding off pressure. Bled back 185 ltr.
00:15 - 01:45: Prepared space on rig floor to run WL pressure control equipment. Prepared permits, and made lifting plan for WL operations.
01:45 - 02:45: Inflow tested the HMV to 185 for 10 min. Bled down well from 185 bar to 0 bar to closed drain system. Meanwhile prepared for wire line operations.
02:45 - 03:00: Performed TBT for rigging down cement spool
03:00 - 05:15: Drained cement spool. R/d and removed cement spool from f-1 c. Meanwhile built wireline riser on rigfloor.
05:15 - 07:00: Lowered WL adapter onto XT and installed same. Meanwhile continued with preparations for r/u WL equipment.
07:00 - 07:30: Performed TBT for r/u WL equipment. Prepared permit and paper work.
07:30 - 08:30: Installed WL BOP lift cap and double securing. Transferred WL BOP from moonpool to WH. Checked o-rings on BOP and installed control hoses. Landed off lower riser and made up to XT.
08:30 - 09:45: R/u hoses and manifold to WL BOP. Filled BOP with SW and performed connection test against SV to 50bar/5min to confirm o-ring seals. Removed lifting equipment in moonpool and lifted tuggers to drill floor.
09:45 - 10:00: Installed BX elevator and inserts.
10:00 - 10:45: P/u WL riser with TDS, RIH and landed off on BOP. M/u connection and l/o handling pup. Meanwhile r/u lines from choke manifold to XT side outlets.
10:45 - 11:15: M/u QTS sub and pump-in sub. Installed 2 lo-torque valves.
11:15 - 12:45: R/u lines from choke manifold to XT outlets. Meanwhile prepared cable head and toolstring for cutting tubing.
12:45 - 13:45: Installed grease lines, control lines and lifted assy on lubricator. R/u sheaves to BX-ELEVATOR. Meanwhile mixed 50/50 MEG.
13:45 - 15:00: P/u lubricator and m/u dummmy toolstring for pressure testing. Continued to prepare toolstring for cutting tubing. Meanwhile flushed cement hose.
15:00 - 15:30: M/u lubricator and QTS.
15:30 - 16:30

sections.text: Bled off well to 185 bar and attampted to close DHSV while bleeding off pressure. Bled back 185 ltr.
Prepared space on rig floor to run WL pressure control equipment. Prepared permits, and made lifting plan for WL operations.
Inflow tested the HMV to 185 for 10 min. Bled down well from 185 bar to 0 bar to closed drain system. Meanwhile prepared for wire line operations.
Performed TBT for rigging down cement spool
Drained cement spool. R/d and removed cement spool from f-1 c. Meanwhile built wireline riser on rigfloor.
Lowered WL adapter onto XT and installed same. Meanwhile continued with preparations for r/u WL equipment.
Performed TBT for r/u WL equipment. Prepared permit and paper work.
Installed WL BOP lift cap and double securing. Transferred WL BOP from moonpool to WH. Checked o-rings on BOP and installed control hoses. Landed off lower riser and made up to XT.

R/u hoses and manifold to WL BOP. Filled BOP with SW and performed connection test against SV to 50bar/5min to confirm o-ring seals. Removed lifting equipment in moonpool and lifted tuggers to drill floor.
Installed BX elevator and inserts.
P/u WL riser with TDS, RIH and landed off on BOP. M/u connection and l/o handling pup. Meanwhile r/u lines from choke manifold to XT side outlets.
M/u QTS sub and pump-in sub. Installed 2 lo-torque valves.
R/u lines from choke manifold to XT outlets. Meanwhile prepared cable head and toolstring for cutting tubing.
Installed grease lines, control lines and lifted assy on lubricator. R/u sheaves to BX-ELEVATOR. Meanwhile mixed 50/50 MEG.
P/u lubricator and m/u dummmy toolstring for pressure testing. Continued to prepare toolstring for cutting tubing. Meanwhile flushed cement hose.
M/u lubricator and QTS.
Confirmed line-up and pressure tested WL rig-up to 20/345 bar for 5/10min.
Performed TBT for handling explosives.
Drained lubricator to closed drain. B/o QTS. Pulled dummy toolstring out of lubricator and l/d same.
R/u for running WL cutter. Meanwhile r/u chiksan and lo-torque valves from XT to choke manifold.
R/u for running WL cutter meanwhile continued m/u chiksan and lo-torque valves from XT to choke manifold.
Performed TBT prior to arming cutter. Meanwhile r/u hoses and chiksan in WH/XT area for circulation.
M/u cutter to CCL and armed. Lifted tool string into lubricator, and lowered lubricator onto riser. M/u and leak tested QTS.
Continued m/u toolstring. Meanwhile continued rigging up hoses for circulation in WH area.
RIH w/ cutter, 40 m/min. Ran slowly through DHSV from 483 mmd to 490 mmd. Unable to pass restriction at 2407 mmd.
